_comment: Files where a request-controlled value reaches a filesystem path with no containment check detectable by scripts/ci/check-path-containment.mjs. Every entry needs a REASON. The digest pins the file contents: change the file and it re-flags, so a baseline cannot quietly cover new code. This list may shrink, never grow.

server/routes/authoring.router.ts.reason: FALSE POSITIVE. `path.join(dir, file)` in loadTemplates(): `dir` is templatesDir() (a server constant, cwd/server/templates/m3) and `file` comes from fs.readdirSync on that directory, filtered to *.json. Neither is request input. The detector matches on the assignment target `content`, which is ALSO bound from req.body elsewhere in this ~4600-line router — a name collision, not a dataflow. (It previously matched on the name `file` for the same reason; the line itself is unchanged.) Re-verified by reading loadTemplates() and templatesDir() in full.

server/routes/protocol_routes.ts.reason: FALSE POSITIVE. `filePath` is `req.file.path` — the path MULTER generated for the upload it just wrote, not a client-supplied string. The client controls `originalname` (used only for path.extname), never the storage path. assertUploadSafe() runs on it first. Verified at both sites (723, 1015).
